title: Permissible Sizes/Rating Classes for Slip-On Flanges Used as Lapped Flanges
notes: GENERAL NOTE: Actual thickness of the slip-on flange at the bolt circle shall be at least equal to the minimum required flange thickness for lapped flanges in ASME B16.5.
